notes.title: Dialogue Bug Resolved
notes.notes: Resolved an issue where some dialogues were not displaying or functioning correctly.

notes.title: Update – New Localizations, Audio Improvements & More!
notes.notes:
[b]New Localizations[/b]
The game is now available in 17 new languages:
German, French, Italian, Korean, Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Russian, Japanese, Portuguese (Portugal), Polish, Hungarian, Czech, Turkish, Brazilian Portuguese, Ukrainian, Latin American Spanish, and more!

[b]Audio Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated and improved several background music tracks for a better immersive experience;
[/list]

[b]NPC & Environment Enhancements[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new animations to various NPCs;
[*] Polished and refined multiple locations for better atmosphere and detail;
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed several minor issues to improve overall stability and gameplay experience;
[/list]
